# plotwork_diagram (Resource)

Publishes a diagram to Plotwork, so the picture changes when the infrastructure does. Without `organization` it goes to the API key's own library and gets a public link; with one, or with an organisation key, it goes to that organisation's private library.

A change to the source publishes a new diagram and then deletes the one it replaced. Set `alias` for a `stable_url` that never changes, to embed in a README or a wiki. Publishing works on every plan.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "plotwork_import" "network" {
  format = "terraform"
  files  = { for f in fileset(path.module, "*.tf") : f => file("${path.module}/${f}") }
}

# A personal diagram with a stable link that never changes.
resource "plotwork_diagram" "network" {
  source = data.plotwork_import.network.source
  name   = "Production network"
  folder = "Platform/Network"
  scheme = "auto"
  alias  = "prod-network"
}

# A diagram in an organisation's private library.
resource "plotwork_diagram" "network_team" {
  source         = data.plotwork_import.network.source
  name           = "Production network"
  organization   = "acme"
  classification = "internal"
}

output "network_diagram" {
  value = plotwork_diagram.network.stable_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source` (String) The Plotwork source to publish: from `plotwork_import`, a `.diagram` file, or `templatefile()`.

### Optional

- `alias` (String) The name of a stable link, such as `prod-network`: lower-case words joined by hyphens. `stable_url` then always shows the latest diagram. Personal libraries only; the plan limits how many an account keeps.
- `classification` (String) For an organisation's diagram: `public`, `internal` or `confidential`. Left out, the folder's or the organisation's default.
- `embed_source` (Boolean) Write the source into the stored SVG so the diagram can be opened in the Plotwork editor. Anyone who can open the picture can then read the source. Left out, a personal diagram leaves it out and an organisation's follows its "Keep diagrams editable" setting.
- `folder` (String) The folder to file it in, outermost first, such as `Platform/Network`. Left out, the top level.
- `name` (String) A label for the diagram in the library. Removing it later keeps the old label.
- `organization` (String) The slug or id of the organisation whose private library holds the diagram. Defaults to the provider's `organization`. Changing it publishes to the new library and deletes the old copy.
- `scheme` (String) `light` (the default), `dark`, or `auto` for one picture that follows the viewer's setting.

### Read-Only

- `bytes` (Number) The size of the stored SVG.
- `expires_at` (String) When the plan's retention deletes it, RFC 3339, or null when the plan keeps it. Each apply that publishes moves it out; a diagram that expired is published again by the next apply.
- `id` (String) The diagram's id in Plotwork.
- `library` (String) Where the diagram is stored: `personal`, or the id of the organisation whose library holds it. An organisation's Publishing setting can send a personal publish to its library.
- `published_at` (String) When it was last published, RFC 3339.
- `stable_url` (String) The address of the stable link named by `alias`. It never changes while the alias stays.
- `url` (String) The public address of the SVG, for a personal diagram. Null for an organisation's, which has none.
- `view_url` (String) The portal page that shows an organisation's diagram to its signed-in members.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A diagram in your own library, by its id.
terraform import plotwork_diagram.network 2b6f0cc9-5b0a-4f0e-9a3c-8f2d1e4b7a10

# A diagram in an organisation's library, as <organisation>/<id>.
terraform import plotwork_diagram.network_team acme/2b6f0cc9-5b0a-4f0e-9a3c-8f2d1e4b7a10
```
